title: Pulaski approach motor-count counterfactual diagnostics
scope: Both directions on McGuinness Boulevard between I-278/Meeker and Greenpoint Avenue; intervening junctions separate this counter from Pulaski Bridge. Vehicles, not people.

design.pre_validation: Earlier-period diagnostic: requested January–August 2014 versus 2015. Boston retains 34/40 cells across eight months; Broadway 22/40 across January–June only. These dates are not guaranteed untreated: the December 2014 plan scheduled an April 2015 project start, while a September 2015 release says construction recently began. Exact temporary and permanent lane-closure dates remain unverified. September 2015–April 2016 is excluded by the analysis, not established as the complete construction interval. See the newer directional analysis for January–February sensitivity.
design.primary_post: Requested May–December 2014 versus 2016. Boston retains 31/40 cells, no December; Broadway 26/40, no July or August. The 2017 sensitivity may include the Kosciuszko opening.
design.controls: Two available non-highway arterial stations with dense 2014/2015 data, both in the Bronx. Kent Avenue begins in 2016 and cannot validate pretrends.
design.weights: Equal retained month × weekday cells; at least two exact-date pairs within each year. Equal cells do not imply equal months when support is incomplete.
design.counterfactual: Mean baseline target × mean post control / mean baseline control, with the same retained-cell weights within each pair.
design.selection: Exploratory diagnostics; no causal significance claim. Different pairwise support prevents fair control ranking. See independent common-three-station audit.

limitations: Approach-road vehicles, not a bridge screenline or all-mode person flow.
Exact permanent motor-lane closure date is unverified.
Both controls are in the Bronx; local trends and co-interventions can differ.
Missing observations and detector changes may affect means; a stable station ID does not establish calibration continuity.
Pairwise estimates use different target samples; see common-support audit.
The 2017 common sample has only two cells, in May.
The 2017 Kosciuszko Bridge opening is a competing network change.
Pre-period checks do not establish exogenous assignment or parallel post-treatment trends.
audit_note: All 36 estimates independently reconcile within 2.2e-11. Common three-station full-day comparison retains 20/40 post cells: raw change −6.68%, relative change −4.91% vs Boston and −9.76% vs Broadway. See audit files.
